name: @payswap/execution-graph
description: Economic Execution Graph (Work Order P3-W2): the canonical typed, versioned representation of proposed or authorized multi-step economic execution — attempts, offers, plans, authorization PROJECTION and reconciliation — plus the strategy model (strategies answer WHAT: settle-now, batch, net-later...) and the Director ADVISORY integration (deterministic controls + replaceable learned components; advisory only, never an authority). ENCODED LAWS: (1) quote/route/provider observation VERSIONS are preserved losslessly (the capability fabric's observations are evidence; the graph keeps the exact version it decided on); (2) affected authorization PROJECTION is invalidated when material execution terms change (the financial protocol layer owns real authorization — this package projects/reconciles, NEVER authorizes; no obligation/clearing/settlement calls); (3) the Director and every strategy artifact is structurally advisory (INV-09/INV-11). Zero runtime dependencies; devDependencies are exactly the toolchain (typescript + vitest). Type-only sibling pins: @payswap/economic, @payswap/protocol, @payswap/capability via tsconfig paths (the accepted P1/P2 integration pattern).
